events.finding: An extra pulse group survives a separate receiver check. The source is unresolved.
Roof-area impacts were checked again from the service yard. Their source is unresolved.
The failed antenna was isolated, repaired and tested out and back before it went back into service.
A moving figure was recorded near the array. Any retained photograph is a separate source; identity and origin remain unresolved.
A recorded feeder disturbance was checked with the affected circuit isolated.
Something came along the service yard fence after dark. I got behind a door and it went away. I did not see what it was.
The extra component does not follow the expected sky-source direction. Local origin remains a possibility.
An unsigned telex references a previously logged observation. Its line and time differ from the reference.
An unoccupied vehicle was inspected. The warm bonnet and clock reading are logged; absence of a driver proves nothing else.
Several lights moved low over the Alderete place, seen from the SARO yard. A retained photograph records that they were there, not what they were.
Several lights moved low over Caliche after dark. A retained photograph records that they were there, not what they were.
The distant lights were compared with a controlled receiver test rather than their first apparent resemblance.
A marked surface and loose fragment were photographed and inspected in place before sampling.
Two records disagree on event time. The independent internal reference excludes one timing path.
An additional print was compared with the retained original and spool log. The original remains unchanged.
A moving light crossed the sky with a low thud behind it. The receiver's stored observation shows nothing of it.
The apparent quiet region was checked from both sides of a recorded field boundary.
A close light-bearing passage produced independent visual and instrument records. No identity is assigned.
A low moving light was photographed between S-02 and S-03. Compare the retained original with a control photograph from the same antenna reference; no identity or common signal source is established.
The control room phone rang once and stopped. Nobody was on the line to ask.
The printer ran for two seconds with nothing queued.
Relays clicked in the rack with no one at it.
The radio opened by itself for a moment.
The service door stood open after it had been shut.
Metal creaked among the dishes with no wind to speak of.
Something tapped along the fence and went off.
The crickets stopped for half a minute, then came back.
